description: The bar chart, titled "effect" and labeled "family" on the horizontal axis, displays the results of a morphosyntactic probing task across various language families and a set of isolated languages. The vertical axis represents the effect size, ranging from -5 to 35, with error bars indicating variability. The chart compares the performance of two models, mBERT and XLM, across four different language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, as well as isolated languages (Isolate), Semitic, and Uralic. Each language family has a set of four bars, color-coded to represent different model configurations: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), and XLM-R₂ (dark green), with a fifth bar for mBERT-B₂ (light red) and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The data shows that the effect sizes vary significantly across families and model configurations. For instance, in the IE-Indic family, the XLM-B₂ model exhibits the highest effect size, exceeding 30, while the mBERT-L₂ model shows a much lower effect. In contrast, for the Uralic family, all models show very low effect sizes, with the mBERT-L₂ model having a value close to zero. The chart also includes a legend to identify the different model configurations and their corresponding colors.
